content.short: Tonstakers is a TON liquid staking protocol where users stake TON, receive tsTON, and use it in DeFi products.
content.description: Tonstakers is a liquid staking protocol and community for TON holders. Users stake TON, receive tsTON, earn staking rewards, and can put tsTON into other TON products, while developers and validators can use the protocol resources around staking. The largest TON liquid staking protocol with 70M+ TON TVL, 100,000+ users, up to 5% APY. Liquid staking protocol and TON stakers community. That makes the app relevant for TON users who need a real DeFi action rather than only a token information page.
